method: non-generative extraction from registered full-face reference
brow_cleanup: Reference outlines traced without intersecting hair lines
tear_cutout: Separate polygons around the pooled tears; subpixel alpha feather and 0.85 source opacity
eye_adjustment: Measured upper lash profile; existing irises and highlights; existing lower line fitted to sclera boundary
tears_parent: Same parent as each sclera; not the moving eyeball
